annotation.title_clean: National Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Robotic Studies (Establishment) Bill, 2023
annotation.title_en: National Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Robotic Studies (Establishment) Bill, 2023
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Assembly of Nigeria (sponsored by Hon. Ademorin A. Kuye)
annotation.venue: National Assembly of the Federal Republic of Nigeria (HB. 143)
annotation.summary_en: Nigerian House bill establishing the National Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Robotic Studies in Somolu, Lagos. It sets out the institute's objects, governing board, academic board, officers, finances and student discipline. It is an institutional and education-focused measure with no regulation of AI or robot systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Institute as a body corporate to provide higher education and training in AI and robotics
Creates a Governing Board appointed by the Minister of Communications and Digital Economy
Sets up the Academic Board, Director-General and principal officers with fixed terms
Establishes a fund financed by federal grants through NBTE, fees and donations, with annual audit and reporting
Aligns the Institute with the National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy
